claim_boundary: At the frozen epsilon=1/2, positive-count floor N=|E| of the independent-binomial conditional-access model inherited from ASMP-9 v0.17-v0.20, establish the exact identity F_G=T_G(0,2)/2^|E| for one finite simple biconnected comparison block. Use the classical Las Vergnas orientation interpretation and Jaeger-Vertigan-Welsh Tutte dichotomy to classify the availability numerator as #P-complete and exact rational value computation as #P-hard under polynomial-time Turing reductions, including Turing-hardness when the input is restricted to biconnected blocks. This is an access-model translation and complexity classification at one boundary, not a novelty claim for the Tutte polynomial or totally cyclic orientations. It does not classify optimizer search, budgets above |E|, arbitrary epsilon, weighted partial orientations, approximation, the full fixed-parameter landscape, adaptive allocation, dependent or misspecified responses, behavioral reward identification, general IRL, or resolve ASMP-9.

allowed: The count-floor availability numerator on a biconnected block is #P-complete under polynomial-time Turing reductions.
Exact rational count-floor value computation is #P-hard.
The restriction to biconnected blocks is #P-hard under a polynomial-time block-decomposition Turing reduction.
forbidden: Optimizer search is hard at the count floor.
The arbitrary-epsilon or above-floor local design problem is classified.
The classical Tutte or orientation results are new.
complexity_statement.membership_witness: A total orientation is encoded by |E| bits and total cyclicity is checkable in polynomial time by directed reachability.
complexity_statement.normalization_recovery: Multiplying the exact rational availability by 2^|E| recovers the integer orientation count.

bridge_scope.name: wheel_7_with_leaf
bridge_scope.required_distinction: T_G(0,2)=0 while the ASMP quotient ignores the bridge and preserves the wheel availability

freshness_rule.candidate_pair_rule: All primary full graphs are pairwise nonisomorphic. Control full graphs are distinct from the prior registry and from each other; their deliberate wheel_7 sub-block reuse is reported.
freshness_rule.exact_check: NetworkX graph isomorphism after matching node and edge counts
freshness_rule.prior_universe: Every dictionary carrying integer node_count and a simple edge-pair list in every earlier ASMP-9 protocol*.json file

inherited_object.endpoint_adversary: one independent binary endpoint label per edge
inherited_object.liveness_event: every original nonbridge edge has mutually reachable endpoints in the residual digraph

prior_art.role: known hardness and classical branchwidth/pathwidth FPT algorithms

statistical_policy: No statistical inference. Every registered quantity is an exact integer, rational, graph predicate, hash, or resource measurement.
